Ho to write this professionally? 
As a way of introduction, I work for Bill Johnson in Global Tech ( nice meeting you ). A situation presented itself where your expertise is needed to be able to address it correctly and find a viable solution that keep us in compliance with the HR rules .

To make the story short, one of our employees ( Koletta Kruk ) works in Poland and she occasionally work hours after 10:00 PM Poland time . Koletta supports Workjam one of our SAAS application and she currently works flexible shift that falls beyond the 10:00 PM Poland time.

Based on the email she drafted to me below , I am hoping that you can shad some lights on how to deal with her asks . Koletta is great performer and she a flexible work hours suits the business well and aligns with the NA support hours .
sample.chosen:
Here's a professional way to rewrite your message:

---

Subject: Request for Guidance on Employee Work Hours Compliance (Koletta Kruk, Poland)

Dear [Recipient's Name],

I hope this message finds you well. I am writing to introduce myself; I work under the guidance of Bill Johnson in the Global Tech department. I am reaching out to seek your expertise in addressing a situation that requires careful consideration to ensure we remain compliant with HR rules.

To provide some context, one of our exceptional employees, Koletta Kruk, based in Poland, occasionally works beyond 10:00 PM local time. Koletta supports our SAAS application, Workjam, and her flexible shift aligns well with our North American support hours. However, we need to ensure that her work schedule adheres to local labor laws and our company's HR policies.

Koletta has expressed her concerns and requests in an email she sent to me, which I have copied below for your reference:

[Insert Koletta's email here]

I kindly request your guidance on how to address Koletta's asks while ensuring we maintain compliance with relevant HR rules. Given Koletta's strong performance and the business benefits of her flexible work arrangement, we aim to find a viable solution that balances her needs with our compliance obligations.

I look forward to your expert insights on this matter. Please let me know if you need any further information from me.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
[Your Position]
Global Tech Department

---
